title: Online learning of which forecaster to trust (Hedge and Thompson sampling)
why: Expert-advice and bandit methods are the production form of reinforcement learning for choosing between models from delayed feedback.
notes: 146 live questions answered by at least two experts over 8 batch days (the live rehearsal record, replayed walk-forward with a two-day outcome lag).
The best expert in hindsight is ml.
limits: The live record is only a few days long: the weights barely move and every interval is wide. This is a mechanism check, not evidence that the blend helps.
The best expert in hindsight is a reference, not something that could be played.
